Each handshake is between one witch and one sorcerer, and no witch shook hands with another witch or with a sorcerer more than once. So the count is 6 × 10 = 60.

Solution 1 is wrong because it counts sorcerer-to-sorcerer handshakes, which the problem rules out. Solution 3 is wrong because it halves 60 on the false premise that each handshake was counted twice. Solution 2 correctly gets 60.

CHOICE: 2
